initial_description:
Here is a detailed description of the illustrative figure, "Stage 4: Structured Arbitration Protocol," designed to represent the methodology described:

**Overall Layout and Styling:**
The diagram will have an aspect ratio of 4:3 (1100 logical units wide by 825 logical units high) and a pure white background. It will be a publication-quality academic data flow diagram with a clean, professional appearance. All text will use a serif font (such as Georgia or Palatino). The design will be flat, with no drop shadows, gradients, 3D effects, clip art, decorative icons, emoji, background patterns, or textures. All arrows will be straight, either vertical or horizontal, with no curved or diagonal paths. All colors used will strictly adhere to the provided Census xdgov palette.

The general flow of information is from top-to-bottom, organized into four distinct horizontal tiers.

---

**Tier 1: Input - Initial Data (Top Center)**
*   **Component**: A rounded rectangle, positioned at the top center of the diagram.
*   **Dimensions**: Approximately 450 logical units wide and 60 logical units high.
*   **Styling**: It will have a pure white fill and a 2px solid border in a soft grey color.
*   **Labels**:
    *   **Line 1**: "1,598 pairs with 3-rater judgments" (10px serif font, dark charcoal text color).
    *   **Line 2**: "All pairs proceed to arbitration (not just disagreements)" (9px serif italic font, muted blue-grey text color).

**Connection: Downward Arrow 1**
*   A single, straight downward arrow connects the center bottom of the "Initial Data" box to the top center of the "Arbitration Protocol" box.
*   **Styling**: 2px solid line in a deep navy blue color.

---

**Tier 2: Arbitration Protocol (Center-Top)**
*   **Component**: A prominent rounded rectangle, centrally positioned below Tier 1. This box represents the core of the structured arbitration process.
*   **Dimensions**: Approximately 500 logical units wide and 130 logical units high.
*   **Styling**: The main body of the box will have a very light orange tint fill (white with a subtle orange hue), with a 2px solid border in a vibrant orange color.
*   **Header Bar**: A distinct header bar spans the top of this box, approximately 25 logical units high.
    *   **Styling**: Filled with the vibrant orange color.
    *   **Label**: "Arbitration Protocol" (11px bold serif font, pure white text).
*   **Body Content**: The body of the box is divided into two conceptual columns, containing descriptive text:
    *   **Left Column (Blind Masking)**:
        *   "Blind masking:" (9px bold serif font, dark charcoal text).
        *   "Raters shown as A, B, C" (9px serif font, dark charcoal text).
        *   "No vendor identity revealed" (9px serif font, dark charcoal text).
    *   **Right Column (Order Randomization)**:
        *   "Order randomization:" (9px bold serif font, dark charcoal text).
        *   "50% fixed presentation order" (9px serif font, dark charcoal text).
        *   "50% randomized (position bias check)" (9px serif font, dark charcoal text).
*   **Bottom Annotation**: Centered below the two columns within the box:
    *   "Each arbitrator sees: all 3 rater judgments + reasoning + original question pair" (8px serif italic font, muted blue-grey text color).

**Connection: Downward Arrow Split**
*   A single, straight downward arrow originates from the bottom center of the "Arbitration Protocol" box.
*   **Styling**: 2px solid line in a deep navy blue color.
*   This arrow then splits evenly into three parallel, straight downward arrows, each leading to one of the "Arbitrator" boxes in Tier 3.

---

**Tier 3: Three Independent Arbitrators (Three Columns)**
This tier consists of three identical modules, arranged horizontally and separated by subtle dashed lines.

*   **Component Template**: Each arbitrator is represented by a rounded rectangle.
    *   **Dimensions**: Approximately 240 logical units wide and 120 logical units high.
    *   **Styling**: The main body of each box will have a light pastel green fill, with a 2px solid border in a deep forest green color.
    *   **Header Bar**: Each box has a header bar, approximately 25 logical units high.
        *   **Styling**: Filled with the deep forest green color.
        *   **Label**: (Specific to each arbitrator, 10px bold serif font, pure white text).
    *   **Body Content**:
        *   Model identifier (8px serif italic font, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "Select rater A, B, or C — or synthesize" (9px serif font, dark charcoal text).
        *   "Provide final barrier + feasibility + reasoning" (9px serif font, dark charcoal text).

*   **Arbitrator 1 (Left)**:
    *   **Header Label**: "Arbitrator 1: Anthropic"
    *   **Body Text**: "claude-opus-4-5"

*   **Arbitrator 2 (Center)**:
    *   **Header Label**: "Arbitrator 2: OpenAI"
    *   **Body Text**: "gpt-5.2"

*   **Arbitrator 3 (Right)**:
    *   **Header Label**: "Arbitrator 3: Google"
    *   **Body Text**: "gemini-3-pro"

*   **Separators**: Thin, 1px dashed vertical lines in a soft grey color will visually separate the three arbitrator boxes.

**Connection: Three Arrows Converging**
*   Three straight downward arrows originate from the bottom center of each of the "Arbitrator" boxes.
*   **Styling**: 2px solid line in a deep navy blue color.
*   These three arrows converge smoothly into a single, straight downward arrow that leads to the top center of the "Post-Arbitration Results" box in Tier 4.

---

**Tier 4: Final Verdicts - Post-Arbitration Results (Bottom Center)**
*   **Component**: A rounded rectangle, centrally positioned at the bottom of the diagram.
*   **Dimensions**: Approximately 500 logical units wide and 160 logical units high.
*   **Styling**: The main body of the box will have a light pastel green fill, with a 2px solid border in a deep forest green color.
*   **Header Bar**: A distinct header bar spans the top of this box, approximately 30 logical units high.
    *   **Styling**: Filled with the deep forest green color.
    *   **Label**: "Post-Arbitration Results" (12px bold serif font, pure white text).
*   **Body Content**: The body of the box is divided into two conceptual columns:
    *   **Left Column (Agreement Improvement)**:
        *   "Feasibility κ: 0.537 → " **0.843** (10px serif font, dark charcoal text, with "0.843" in bold deep forest green).
        *   "Barrier κ: 0.611 → 0.796" (10px serif font, dark charcoal text).
        *   "Binary κ: — → " **0.896** (10px serif font, dark charcoal text, with "0.896" in bold deep forest green).
        *   "Both quality gates: " **PASSED** (10px bold serif font, deep forest green text).
    *   **Right Column (Output Artifacts)**:
        *   "→ final_verdicts.csv" (9px serif italic font, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "→ arbitration_merged.csv" (9px serif italic font, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "→ stage3_arbitration_metrics.json" (9px serif italic font, muted blue-grey text).
        *   (Blank line for spacing)
        *   "1,598 pairs with consensus verdicts" (9px bold serif font, dark charcoal text).

---

**Left Margin Annotation: Trust Architecture**
*   A vertical bracket will be positioned along the left margin of the diagram.
*   **Styling**: The bracket will be in a vibrant orange color, with a 2px thickness. It will visually span vertically from the top of the "Arbitration Protocol" box (Tier 2) down to the bottom of the "Three Arbitrators" tier (Tier 3), encompassing both.
*   **Labels**: Text labels will be aligned to the right of this bracket, describing aspects of the trust architecture:
    *   "Trust architecture" (9px bold serif font, vibrant orange text).
    *   Below, with slight vertical spacing:
        *   "Blind masking prevents" (8px serif font, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "anchoring bias" (8px serif font, muted blue-grey text).
    *   Below, with slight vertical spacing:
        *   "Order randomization" (8px serif font, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "detects position effects" (8px serif font, muted blue-grey text).
    *   Below, with slight vertical spacing:
        *   "Vendor independence" (8px serif font, muted blue-grey text).
        *   "prevents systematic bias" (8px serif font, muted blue-grey text).
